title: Does Dragonwilds Need New Regions or Better Old Ones? | DGW Podcast #1
author: CrossRSDW
chapters: What makes an old region feel new?
How have backfill patches been received?
What to do when you enter a new region
description:
This is Dragons Gone Wild, the first community-driven podcast for RuneScape: Dragonwilds, where we go deep with the game and its mechanics. I'm your host, ‪@CrossRSDW‬, and I'm joined by my co-host ‪@accurious‬.

Today in Episode 1, we dive deep into the question, of whether Jagex should spend time adding content to old regions, or if they should just focus on new ones.

0:00 Intro
2:32 What makes an old region feel new?
12:22 How have backfill patches been received?
26:12 Barriers to backfilling
33:08 What can new regions offer?
39:03 What to do when you enter a new region
42:58 Who benefits from each?
47:53 What would you change?
